name: Castilleja de Guzmán (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Castilleja de Guzmán (a castle, cauldrons and a pile on white and blue).
history: Municipal flag of Castilleja de Guzmán; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
